地形剖面；盆地形成与积水时间压缩，湖水不是熔岩变成的。: Terrain cross section; basin formation and filling are compressed in time. Lake water is not transformed lava.
先有火山活动，但并不是每座火山后来都会变成湖。需要先有能装水的低洼地方。: Volcanic activity comes first, but not every volcano becomes a lake. A depression capable of holding water is needed.
较小的火山口可以装水。一次大喷发后，山体也可能塌陷，形成更大的破火山口。: A smaller volcanic crater can hold water. After a major eruption, collapse may form a much larger depression called a caldera.
雨水、融雪和地下水可以进入湖盆。水来得比流失得多，湖面才会慢慢升高。: Rain, snowmelt and groundwater may enter the basin. The lake rises only when more water arrives than is lost.
湖水还会蒸发、渗漏或流出。如果漏得太快，即使有一个大坑，也未必能留住湖。: Water also evaporates, seeps out or overflows. A large hollow may fail to hold a lake if it loses water too quickly.
火山湖的盆地可由爆炸形成的火山口、岩浆撤出后的塌陷破火山口或其他火山地形产生。本: Volcanic lake basins can form in explosion craters, collapse calderas after magma withdrawal, or other volcanic terrain. This compares the first two.
破火山口塌陷与地下岩浆支撑减少有关，并不是山顶简单地被炸飞。不同事件的盆地构造与: Caldera collapse is associated with reduced support as magma is withdrawn; the summit is not simply blown away. Basin structure and evolution vary among events.
教学水量平衡为输入减去蒸发与渗漏，再限制在盆地容量内。滑块代表相对供水量，不对应: The teaching water balance subtracts evaporation and leakage from input, bounded by basin capacity. The slider gives relative water supply, not rainfall in millimeters or real years.
成湖还取决于气候、岩石渗透性、地下水位和溢流口。火山湖可能仍有热液活动；成湖并不: Lake formation also depends on climate, rock permeability, groundwater and outlets. Hydrothermal activity may persist; a lake does not imply permanent volcanic extinction.

火山湖需要能够蓄水的地形。喷发口周围可留下较小火山口；大量岩浆撤出或重新分布后，: A volcanic lake needs a basin that can hold water. A smaller crater can remain around a vent; withdrawal or redistribution of substantial magma may allow overlying rock to subside along faults into a larger caldera. Not every volcano develops a lake.
火山口与破火山口的名称描述成因和结构，不能只凭屏幕宽窄判断。美国 Crater: Crater and caldera describe origin and structure, not simply screen width. Despite its name, the main basin of Crater Lake in Oregon is a caldera.

山体塌陷不是整座山凭空消失，也不要求留下一个长期空着的地下洞穴。: Collapse does not make an entire mountain vanish or require a permanently empty underground cavern.

当前读数表示相对水深，而非湖水体积、蓄水年数或实测湖深。: The readout is relative water depth, not water volume, years of filling or a measured lake depth.
降水、融雪、地表径流与地下水可以补给湖水；蒸发、渗漏和溢流使水流失。输入长期大于: Precipitation, snowmelt, surface runoff and groundwater can supply a lake. Evaporation, seepage and overflow remove water. Storage rises when input exceeds output and falls when losses dominate. A basin alone does not create water.
P、E 是降水与蒸发的水深速率，A 为湖面面积；各 Q 是体积流率。实际计算需统: P and E are precipitation and evaporation depth rates over area A; Q terms are volume rates. Real calculations require consistent units and catchment inputs; this page compares relative balance scenarios.
保持湖盆不变，增大地下渗漏，再增加供水，看水能不能积起来。: Keep the basin fixed, increase seepage and then raise supply to see whether water can accumulate.
调节参数会重算同一段形成情景，不是继续模拟上一状态的湖水突然排空。: Changing settings recomputes the same formation scenario; it is not a continuation in which the previous lake suddenly drains.
岩石裂隙和渗透性影响漏水，湖面接近出口时还可能溢流。地下热源可继续加热水体或输入: Fractures and permeability affect seepage, and a lake can overflow when it reaches an outlet. Subsurface heat may continue warming water or supplying dissolved material, so a volcanic lake does not establish permanent volcanic inactivity.

观察蓝色渗漏箭头：水进入岩石孔隙和裂缝，不是熔岩变成了湖水。: Follow the blue seepage arrows: water enters rock pores and fractures; lava has not transformed into lake water.
火山湖装的是水，熔岩湖装的是高温熔岩，二者的物质与过程不同。: A volcanic lake contains water; a lava lake contains hot lava. Their materials and processes differ.

先看地下橙色的区域。一部分岩浆沿通道喷出，或流向别处，储存区里的压力随之下降。不: Look at the orange region underground. Some magma erupts through pathways or moves elsewhere, reducing pressure in the reservoir. Withdrawal comes before the large depression forms.
岩浆撤出后，储存区对上方岩体的支撑可能减弱。上面的岩石仍然很重；如果支撑不足，裂: Magma withdrawal can reduce support for the heavy rock above. If support becomes insufficient, fractures spread. Watch the dark faults on both sides before the ground drops significantly.
上方岩体在重力作用下沿断裂下沉，留下宽大的破火山口。跟着相同的岩层条纹看：它们向: Gravity pulls the overlying rock down along faults, leaving a broad caldera. Follow the same layers as they move downward: the mountain has not vanished, and the depression is not simply a blast hole.
塌陷先留下低洼盆地。后来雨水、融雪等补给超过渗漏和蒸发，才可能形成湖。这里把相隔: Collapse leaves a depression. Much later, rain, snowmelt and other inputs may exceed seepage and evaporation, allowing a lake to form. The animation joins stages separated by long periods; cooling lava does not turn into water.
喷口周围的爆发、物质堆积和局部坍落可以留下较小火山口。这里没有演示破火山口那种大: Explosions, deposits and local collapse around a vent can leave a smaller crater. This option does not illustrate the large-scale fault-bounded subsidence of a caldera. Whether it becomes a lake still depends on retaining water.
先看岩浆撤出，再看岩层和断裂：哪一个变化先发生？: Watch magma withdrawal, then the layers and faults. Which change happens first?
岩浆喷出或侧向迁移后，储存区压力可能下降，上方岩体受到的支撑随之改变。覆岩自重和: Eruption or lateral magma migration can lower reservoir pressure and change support for the overlying rock. Overburden weight and stresses promote fractures; after failure, rock may subside along ring faults. This common collapse mechanism does not require complete evacuation of the magma.
岩浆量、裂隙和沉降的画面只表示过程关系，不是实测压力、岩石强度或位移。真实塌陷可: Displayed magma, fractures and subsidence illustrate a sequence, not measured pressures, rock strengths or displacements. Real collapse may overlap with eruption; the animation separates steps to make the cause clear.
支撑减弱 + 重力作用 → 岩体沿断裂下沉: Reduced support + gravity → subsidence along faults
